mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior three months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.05 percentage points over the prior three months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.25% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises above 0.25% in a single month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in housing starts indicates deteriorating economic conditions, triggering a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE rises by at least 0.1pp and HOUST falls by at least 5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, high consumer credit levels (RSAFS > $400 billion) indicate over-leverage and increased risk of financial stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS exceeds $400 billion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions and rising consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 persons over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 500,000 units signals weak consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST falls below 500.0 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and slowdown in GDP growth indicates a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% and GDPC1 growth rate falls below 1.0% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL year-over-year change exceeds 2.5%.
